import subprocess,time,re
def run(*args,timeout=55): return subprocess.run(["adb",*args],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
r=run("devices","-l")
usb=[]
for line in r.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    if len(p)>=2 and p[1]=="device" and ("usb:" in line or (":" not in p[0] and not p[0].startswith("emulator-"))):usb.append(p[0])
if len(usb)!=1:raise SystemExit("UNEXPECTED_USB_DEVICE_COUNT")
serial=usb[0]
def shell(*args):
    return run("-s",serial,"shell",*args)
model=shell("getprop","ro.product.model")
if model.stdout.strip()!="SM-S906B":raise SystemExit("WRONG_PHONE")
installed=shell("pm","path","io.blueeye")
print("PACKAGE_PRESENT",installed.returncode==0 and "package:" in installed.stdout)
launch=shell("am","start","-W","-n","io.blueeye/.MainActivity")
print("EXPLICIT_START_EXIT",launch.returncode)
print("EXPLICIT_START_OUTPUT", " | ".join((launch.stdout+" "+launch.stderr).splitlines())[:1000])
time.sleep(5)
p=shell("pidof","io.blueeye")
print("PROCESS_ALIVE",p.returncode==0 and bool(p.stdout.strip()))
focused=shell("dumpsys","activity","activities")
lines=focused.stdout.splitlines()
matching=[l.strip() for l in lines if "mResumedActivity:" in l or "topResumedActivity=" in l]
print("APP_FOREGROUND",any("io.blueeye" in l for l in matching))
if p.returncode!=0 or not p.stdout.strip():
    logs=shell("logcat","-d","-t","2000","-s","AndroidRuntime:E")
    relevant=logs.stdout.splitlines()
    fatal=[i for i,l in enumerate(relevant) if "FATAL EXCEPTION" in l]
    if fatal:
        i=fatal[-1]
        excerpt=relevant[i:i+18]
        cleaned=[]
        for line in excerpt:
            if "io.blueeye" in line or "Exception" in line or re.search(r"at io\\.blueeye",line):
                cleaned.append(line[:250])
        print("LATEST_ANDROID_RUNTIME_CRASH", " | ".join(cleaned[:12])[:1300])
    else:
        print("ANDROID_RUNTIME_FATAL_NOT_FOUND")
print("EXPLICIT_LAUNCH_VALIDATION", "PASS" if p.returncode==0 and bool(p.stdout.strip()) else "FAIL")
